snippet.title: Shape Shifter (Full Game)
snippet.description:
Reach the exit door in this fancy, physics-based platform puzzler Shape Shifter. Switch the shapes of the three given animals to overcome all obstacles as you also try to pick up all golden stars in each stage.
Thanks for Like and Subscribe.
